item.title: Cyclists Criticize Loss of Protected Lanes on University Ave
item.description: A bike lane on University Avenue was removed just months after being built and replaced with a shared pedestrian-bike path. The city spent about $124K on the original separated lane, then $401K to replace it after saying it didn’t meet expectations. Cyclists question Rochester’s decision to remove University Avenue bike lane – WHEC.com

item.title: Recall On Children’s Ibuprofen Due To Reports of Foreign Substances
item.description: Nearly 90,000 bottles of children’s ibuprofen are being recalled because they may contain a foreign substance, according to a notice issued by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
